newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Blue chip gains spur Bratislava bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue chip gains spur Bratislava bourse higher.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed mostly higher in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Wednesday, boosting the SAX index 3.2 points to 186.91.

Oil and gas storage company Nafta led thew way on the BSE floor, closing up 100 crowns at 1,700, while oil refiner Slovnaft rose 11 crowns at 790, and VUB, the country's largest commercial bank gained 35 crowns to 1,650.
"We see Nafta constantly climbing, but still there is only weak demand for this issue, so its rise can stop soon," Dusan Sykora of ING Barings said.

Sykora, however, said the market is generally showing signs of an upward trend. "One can expect overall growth on the bourse in next couple of days, which might be even quicker if Slovnaft wakes up," he said.
Steel maker VSZ was one of the few declining blue chips, easing six crowns to 654.
Overall volume eased to 516,105 shares, from 575,562 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover fell to 186.1 million crowns, from 425.23 million.
